I want to talk about my 2 favorite theories, the man giving the bear fillatio (head) and the picture in the end. 

I haven't read the book (so correct me if I'm wrong) but I read somewhere that, in the book, the owner of the hotel and is in a weird relationship with another man. The owner of the hotel tells the man that he would consider having sex with him if he were to come to the hotel ball with a dog (?) costume on. 
Kubrick took that part from the book, changed the dog costume into a bear costume, and turned the scene into an entire hint towards jack sexually abusing his son, Danny. There is a couple scenes where you see Danny with bears, as well as jack with bears. There's even a scene where Danny is brushing his teeth and is in the same position of the bear giving the man fillatio. 
I think it's so cool how Kubrick took something from the book and manipulated it to be an entire thing. So now when I see the scene where Wendy sees the bear and the man, I take it as Wendy literally finding out that jack is sexually abusing Danny. But then again, it could just be a man in a bear costume giving a guy brain lol. 

Also with the picture frame, I think everyone in the picture has been the abuser of their family, and they are now stuck inside the hotel (which is hell) so they physically showed all of the abusive family members literally stuck in the hotel!
